units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 11:39">Targ. Jud. XI, 39</cite> a. fr. [Usu.: <cite ref="E00384"><he>הֵיךְ מָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="E00384"><he>הֵיכְמָא</he></cite>.]—

senses.gloss: (mostly כמה) how! how many!, how much!, how long!; (also interrog.) how much? &c.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 139:17">Targ. Ps. CXXXIX, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 35:17">Ib. XXXV, 17</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6:7">Gen. R. s. 6</cite> <he>כ׳ נפשיה וכ׳</he> how the soul of this man’s (my) brother is now chopping cedars and sawing &c. (is in the agony of death)! (Midr. Sam. ch. IX; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 743">Yalk. Ps. 743</cite>, only <he>נפשיה וכ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:12">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ ככרין וכ׳</he> how many cakes of nardus do we owe to &c.!—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:24">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>כל כ׳ דהוה וכ׳</he> as long as &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:13">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ</cite> top <he>כְּמָן קטל</he> how many of them did he kill?
